scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He is not your son. That money is not yours.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: Then decide which one you want to keep.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He ended the call. My recording started too late.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I thought hearing his voice would make this easier to prove. Now I can only hear what he said.
